name: A Promise Weathered to Nothing
overview: In love with Irene Thayer since their school days, Oscar Eaton gave up a promising future to become her secretary, finally earning a place by her side after a one- night stand. But everything changes four years later when her first love, Aaron Paxton, returns. Heartbroken, Oscar walks away to build a life of his own-while the echo of regret begins to stir in Irene's heart.  (Source: DramaBoxdb)
